components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile and confident primary action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), background 0.3s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview: This system emphasizes fluid, seamless transitions and a modern, tactile feel that breathes life into enterprise data. Interactions should feel native, smooth, and highly responsive, turning mundane QMS tasks into a satisfying experience. We explicitly reject the dense, clunky, and static legacy enterprise UI patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Deep, soft shadows for spatial separation.
dos: Do use large, readable typography (Inter) to ensure legibility for all employee age groups.
Do apply smooth, fluid transitions (duration-300 ease-out) to state changes.
Do maintain high contrast between text and its background.
donts: Don't build dense, clunky, or overly complex navigation structures (no legacy enterprise UI).
Don't use sharp, rigid corners (rounded-none) for primary containers or buttons.
Don't pack information too tightly; let the layout breathe.
